name: Infiltrating the Cult
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
You may or may not be aware of this, but Sania Silverstream over there is a "missionary" for the Al'Aketh. They like to play at being a normal religious order and send non-threatening emissaries around to recruit. We've tolerated Sania so far to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but its obvious the illusion of peace won't last much longer.

You are new here and unknown to most, so I'd like to see if you can use Sania to get close to the cult and find out what their plans are for the village.
narrative.objectives: Speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village.
narrative.offerRewardText: Greetings child, my name is Sania Silverstream and I am a junior priestess in the Order of the Al'Aketh. Do you wish to learn more of our sovereign, the Windlord Al'Akir?There is always room at the Windlord's table for the righteous and the repentant.

chain.subtitle: 5 quests at level 8, 1,650 XP in all.

quests.name: Infiltrating the Cult
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Sania Silverstream in Shen'dar Village.

quests.name: Falaath Village
quests.objectiveText: Report to Missionary Jasaan near the entrance to Falaath Village.

quests.name: Among the Faithful
quests.objectiveText: Look around Falaath Village to learn about the cult's intentions in the Shen'dar Highlands.

quests.name: Havoc in the Highlands
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the ruins of Falaath Village and slay 6 Al'Aketh Stormcallers, 4 Living Lightning and take the head of Commander Cyclas.

quests.name: To Valanaar
quests.objectiveText: Deliver Aonda's Written Report to Valennia Stormfist in Valanaar.
